blocks.text: A rush of prophetic events bringing sweeping political and religious changes coming. The earth is preparing for one world government. Nation after nation is in severe disruption, especially in the Middle East. The United Nations has made it clear that the type of government that has been there will no longer be tolerated, opening the door for the long awaited peace agreement. A great deal of the work has already been done, only awaiting for the final changes to take place. One sure thing to be looking for before the return of Christ is this important covenant. This will be our way to tell exactly where time is at. There will be a space of time go by before the anti-Christ confirms the peace agreement. Now let us take a close look at how Brother Neal Frisby wrote this. – “There is coming a catastrophic showdown. The crises coming will be of such major intensity that dictatorship will be the only kind of government possible. This strange World Leader will arrive according to Dan. 9:27, “And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week.” We are in the midnight hour! We’re getting closer to the translation. We are turning the corner of time of God’s final prophecies for the translative church! “Be ye also ready, for it will come in an hour that ye think not!” (Matt. 24:44) Brother Frisby had a special way to place time and events together. He wrote much more than what we have just quoted. I will continue this later. But right now I have a wonderful part of this letter that Brother Frisby wrote, and now that quote. “Let us take a moment and go back through Bible history and then bring things up to date. – Even the very first part of Genesis spoke about the coming of the Saviour, but men took no heed. Just before the flood, the same as today, the Lord warned the degenerate population through signs in the heavens and by prophets that an awesome flood was approaching, bringing with it severe destruction!” – (Rom. 1:18-22) “Paul revealed the occurrence also! – It is said even before this event that some of the sons of Seth, evidently with the involvement of Enoch, built a monument in stone (the Great Pyramid.) Even historical writers say the Pyramid survived the flood!” – “And in this monument they prophesied of the coming of the flood and even the cryptic lines leaped forward and said the world would finally be destroyed by fire as the elements melt with fervent heat!” (II Peter 3:5- 10) – “It also spoke of the first and final coming of the Lord Jesus Christ to judge the world! – Jude 1:14-15, Enoch is mentioned! – And according to the prophetic lines and the infallible words of the Bible we are headed for tremendous events as the age ends. Some will take heed to the warnings, but others, just like in the days of the flood, will think that things will go on forever just the way they are! – But they definitely won’t! – In St. Matt. 16:3, “Jesus said the religious professors and the sinners could discern the face of the skies, but were so blinded by the cares of life that they could not discern the times right before their eyes!” – “Jesus also said, but as the days of Noah were, so would it be again at His coming! – Christians should be profoundly aware of His nearness!” Matt. 24:33, “When ye shall see these things know that it is near, even at the doors! – And when these things shall begin to come to pass, then look up! And lift up your heads because our redemption is near!” (Luke 21:28) – “And we have seen nearly all the major events the Bible spoke of concerning His Church has come to pass or is now fulfilling before our eyes! – Especially the Mid East and prophecies concerning the Hebrews! – And other signs too numerous to mention here!” – “So the translation and the Jubilee rest is not too far away! – So let us work, act and pray for souls! – Jesus said, “Behold I come quickly!” – meaning that events will occur suddenly and swiftly as the age closes out!” Because of the cares of this world, good and sincere helpers will be hard to come by in this final age, but as we pray we will get our part, and I appreciate you and all my partners in their steadfastness! But this is prophetic and falls in line with what the Scriptures say! – Let’s take note of some trends in the past and we will know what to expect in the future! (Matt. 20:16 – Luke 8:13-15) The Bible says that 8 souls were saved during the time of the flood. (II Peter 2:5) – And only 3 souls survived the fiery holocaust of Sodom! – And only 500 witnessed Jesus when He went away after His first coming! (I Cor. 15:6) And then the Lord Jesus said, “In our day MANY were called, but FEW are chosen to really get the job done! – And believe me they most certainly will fulfill His commandment! – It will be done! – The harvest of the elect will take place and we will be rewarded and blessed beyond measure in this time and in the time to come!” End quote. – This is a very important letter. These events will take place before the anti-Christ appears. We see many countries now dealing in gold. They are preparing for commercial Babylon, Rev. 18:12 and religious Babylon, Rev. 17:4. Due to the Iranian crises many countries are trading their gold for Iranian oil. This is to bypass the UN sanctions on Iran. Finally the currencies on earth as we know them will become worthless. Only the anti-Christ money leading into the mark will be allowed. This will give him absolute control. This month we have a new Special Writing book Volume Ten called “Night Vision – Armageddon Prophecy” as well as a new DVD called “Invasion – Armageddon Battle” (See offer below.) – Due to the length of this letter, trusting all will do their very best to support this most vital message. May the Lord continue to bless and guide each and every one of you in this most important hour. Your Brother in Christ,
